description: Angular component for a single todo list item, providing UI and event emitters for toggling completion and removal.

classes.name: TodoItemComponent
classes.description: Angular presentational component representing a single todo item with toggle and remove functionalities.

methods.name: onToggle
methods.description: Emits the todo item's ID when the toggle checkbox is changed.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Emits the todo item's ID when the remove button is clicked.
